messages.author: f79b33fe507b6757
messages.subject: CTMM Error Model
parts:
Hi Chris, 

My name is Jelisa Oliveras. I am new to CTMM package. I am using CTMM to find  Black and White Ruffled Lemurs home ranges in Madagascar. 

I formatted my data like the MoveBank format. I have 11 months of data from February through December. The lemurs are tracked in 10-minute intervals when sighted.

I keep getting the following message from as.telemetry:
Warning messages:
1: In telemetry.clean(telist[[i]], id = id[i]) :
  Times might be out of order or duplicated in Radio-Green. Make sure that time format and timezone are correctly specified.
2: In telemetry.clean(telist[[i]], id = id[i]) :
  Duplicate data in Radio-Green removed.
3: In telemetry.clean(telist[[i]], id = id[i]) :
 Duplicate times in Radio-Green. Data cannot be fit without an error model.

I checked my dataset there are no duplicates or time out of order. CTMM still lets me plot my model. However, when I when I get to my variogram it states I need an error model.

fitted.mods2 <- ctmm.select(rg, CTMM=GUESS2, verbose=TRUE)
Error in stats::optim(par = par, fn = fn, method = method, lower = lower,  : 
function cannot be evaluated at initial parameters
In addition: Warning message:
In ctmm.loglike(data, CTMM, REML = REML, zero = -zero, profile = profile) : Duplicate timestamps require an error model.

Do you have any suggestion on how to fix this problem? I appreciated it.  

Thank you for your help in advance, 
Jelisa Oliveras

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: CTMM Error Model
parts:
Hi Jelisa,

If you get those warnings but don't have those issues in your CSV file, then you want to make sure that the time format and time zone arguments are allowing as.POSIXct() to correctly interpret your timestamps. See help("strptime").

Best,
Chris
